edits.old_string: It is a decision ask naming every open umbrella and every child in flight beneath it, at every depth. On the ruling it lands at once on its own branch, its diff operator-approved, through `crucible:finishing-a-development-branch`.
edits.new_string: It is a decision ask naming every open umbrella and every child in flight beneath it, at every depth, whose ruling also decides whether the change takes a campaign: an umbrella's review is a spec campaign or the operator's approval (umbrellas.md § Review). On the ruling it lands at once on its own branch, after the campaign where the ruling calls for one, its diff operator-approved, through `crucible:finishing-a-development-branch`.

note: Rewrote the binding-change paragraph's decision-ask and landing sentences so the operator's ruling also decides whether the change takes a campaign (umbrellas.md § Review), and landing follows that campaign where one is ruled.
